name: Chihaya Castle
description: Chihaya Castle was the mountain stronghold where Kusunoki Masashige held out for the Emperor in 1333 against overwhelming Kamakura forces — the archetype of the loyal-general legend. Ruins crown Mt. Kongo.
notes: Access is via the Kongo-san ropeway; the ruins are free and sit on the pilgrimage route to Chihaya Shrine.
